Suppressed:
• Rating 1: Researcher has no access to collection: Internal documentation such as a donor/control file or brief or inaccessible accession record serves as the only description of the collection.   • Rating 2: Researcher has poor access to collection: Collection has no finding aid or a substandard finding aid. The collection has printed catalog cards or another type of offline collection‐level description, but no collection‐level MARC record in the OPAC or a national bibliographic utility. Collection has no finding aid or a substandard finding aid. The collection has a MARC record in the OPAC or national bibliographic utility, but that does not provide sufficient access because it is a large or complex collection. In either case, the collection may be described in other online or offline sources available to researchers, but because of the complexity of the collection or the inadequacy of the sources, this provides insufficient access.
  • Rating 3: Researcher has fair access to collection: The finding aid is substandard or there is no finding aid. There is a collection‐level MARC record for the collection in the institutionʹs OPAC and/or in a national bibliographic utility such as OCLC. In the absence of a full MARC record, there is another type of online collection‐level description.   • Rating 4: Researcher has good access to collection: There is a good finding aid, but it is not available online. There is a collection‐level MARC record for the collection in the institutionʹs OPAC and/or in a national bibliographic utility such as OCLC. In both cases, the collection may also be described in other online or offline sources that are available to researchers.
  • Rating 5: Researcher has excellent access to collection: There is a good online finding aid (EAD,HTML, PDF, or other format). There is a collection‐level MARC record for the collection in the institutionʹs OPAC and/or in a national bibliographic utility such as OCLC.   • 評価3 ：日付、文書の種類、機能、ソース、またはその他の特性による粗い配置。論文は徹底的にスクリーニングされていませんが、広げられて平らになっています。シリーズは完全に確立されていません。ファイルが完全に確立されていない。研究者は、しばしば、適切な物品を見つけるために大量の外来物質を通って作業しなければならない。単一のボリュームに複数の使用があったり、アイテムがペーストされたり、多少混乱したりする可能性があります。
  • 評価4 ：ファイルレベルと直列に配置。一般にファイル内には良い順序があります。単一のボリュームは整然としています（すなわち、アルファベット順の勘定科目または主題順のきちんとしたスクラップブック）。
  • 評価5 ：一連のアイテムレベルへの完全なアレンジ、および必要に応じてサブシリーズ。単一のボリュームは整然としたものであり、インデックスされています（つまり、名前インデックスを持つ年代順のアカウント）。

These are templates for uploading spreadsheet data into ArchivesSpace using the different import options in the Background Jobs area. The data required for a successful import depends on the type of record being created. You do not have to fill out every row and column.

Each CSV template includes a row of sample data. Unless you want to create a record with the sample data, please delete the sample data before uploading your spreadsheet. Do not delete the header row or rearrange existing columns. You may add columns only by duplicating a complete numbered group and changing its index (for example, copy every extent_1_* column as extent_2_* or extent_12_*; skipped numbers are allowed). The Excel templates include additional instructions for using the templates and validations for certain cells. Do not delete the instructions or validations.

各 CSV テンプレートには、サンプルデータの行が 1 行入っています。サンプルデータでレコードを作成するつもりがなければ、スプレッドシートをアップロードする前にサンプルデータを削除してください。見出しの行は削除せず、列の追加や既存の列の並べ替えもしないでください。

Suppressed: Create Accession records plus Extents, External Documents, Subjects, Agents, and Instances with Top Containers. The download includes one _1 group for each of those. Link an existing Subject with subject_1_record_id, giving either a numeric ID such as 197 or a full URI such as /subjects/197. Link an existing Agent with agent_1_record_id the same way; agent_1_agent_type is required when you give a numeric ID and optional when you give a URI such as /agents/people/5. Do not fill link and create fields in the same group. Link an existing Top Container with a full URI such as /repositories/2/top_containers/5, or with its barcode on its own. A barcode by itself links the Top Container holding it, whether that Top Container already existed or an earlier row created it, and the import fails if no Top Container in the repository has that barcode. Filling any other Top Container field alongside a barcode instead creates a new Top Container carrying that barcode, with indicator required, and the import fails if that barcode is already in use in the repository.
